origin: KiCad schematics by the maintainer, exported for ngspice, and variants of them made for M13, each changing one form; mesfet_common_source.cir is authored
author: xdylanm
notes: Q, M, J and Z devices for M13. Most files include jellybean.lib from openjellybean 0.5.0 (https://github.com/xdylanm/openjellybean, MIT), which is not copied here: the solver sweep runs them when OPENJELLYBEAN_LIB names that file. Three files carry copied openjellybean model blocks with their notice. Provenance confirmed by the maintainer, 2026-11-05.

bjt_emitter_follower.cir.note: Offset-compensated emitter follower: an NPN and a PNP from jellybean.lib.

cmos_discrete_xor.cir.note: XOR from discrete VDMOS parts, N and P, from jellybean.lib.

cmos_xor.cir.note: CMOS XOR: 4-node NMOS and PMOS, level=8 models and l=, w=, m=.

edges.cir.note: Edge detector: op-amps and a potentiometer from jellybean.lib, NPNs and diodes.

sample_and_hold.cir.note: Sample and hold: a JFET switch and an op-amp from jellybean.lib.

cmos_xor_geometry.cir.note: cmos_xor.cir with ad, as, pd and ps.

cmos_xor_geometry_upper.cir.note: cmos_xor.cir with upper-case names and values, nrd and nrs.

cmos_xor_continued.cir.note: cmos_xor.cir with the parameters on + continuation lines.

cmos_xor_off.cir.note: cmos_xor.cir with off on one MOSFET.

cmos_xor_version.cir.note: cmos_xor.cir with version=3.3.0 on the level 8 models.

cmos_xor_model_params.cir.note: cmos_xor.cir with model parameters in parentheses, continued.

cmos_xor_level1_temp.cir.note: cmos_xor.cir with level 1 models and temp=, which stops ngspice on level 8.

bjt_emitter_follower_substrate.cir.note: bjt_emitter_follower.cir with a substrate node on each BJT.

bjt_emitter_follower_area.cir.note: bjt_emitter_follower.cir with area=, areab= and areac=.

bjt_emitter_follower_off_ic.cir.note: bjt_emitter_follower.cir with off on Q2 and IC=0.6, 2.5 on Q1, and uic.

bjt_emitter_follower_temp.cir.note: bjt_emitter_follower.cir with temp=, dtemp= and m=.

bjt_emitter_follower_local_models.cir.note: bjt_emitter_follower.cir with its models copied from openjellybean 0.5.0.

bjt_emitter_follower_vbic_tj.cir.note: bjt_emitter_follower.cir with VBIC (level=4) models and a junction temperature node.

bjt_emitter_follower_2n3904.cir.note: bjt_emitter_follower.cir with model names that start with a digit.

bjt_emitter_follower_node_like_model.cir.note: bjt_emitter_follower.cir with a node named like a model.

bjt_emitter_follower_subckt.cir.note: bjt_emitter_follower.cir with the transistors and their models in a .subckt.

cmos_discrete_xor_local_models.cir.note: cmos_discrete_xor.cir with its models copied from openjellybean 0.5.0, BS250_OJ with pchan.

cmos_discrete_xor_m_off.cir.note: cmos_discrete_xor.cir with VDMOS m= and off.

sample_and_hold_jfet_area_off.cir.note: sample_and_hold.cir with a positional JFET area and off.

sample_and_hold_jfet_ic_temp.cir.note: sample_and_hold.cir with JFET ic= and temp=, and uic.

sample_and_hold_pjf.cir.note: sample_and_hold.cir with a P-channel JFET and the diode reversed.

sample_and_hold_jfet_named_area.cir.note: sample_and_hold.cir with area= by name, which runs but the manual does not show.

mesfet_common_source.cir.note: MESFET (NMF) common-source stage with positional area, off and ic=; authored, not from KiCad.
